{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rates for each channel
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract the conversion rates for email and paid_search
email_conversion_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_conversion_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute the difference (email - paid_search)
difference = email_conversion_rate - paid_search_conversion_rate

# Output the results
email_conversion_rate, paid_search_conversion_rate, difference"}
